messages:
Maya L.: Heads up — we’re seeing high packet loss (~30-50%) from ISP-X between LAX/SEA POPs to na-west-gpu-1. gRPC latency spikes and health checks flapping. Backend pool showing ~20% degraded nodes and a 2m request queue growth. I’m going to propose a traffic shift.
Amit: link to graphs? :eyes: 
Maya L.: https://dash.internal/redwood/graphs?panel=egress_isp_x_na_west — top panel is SYN retrans, second is gRPC p50/p95. Health checks returning intermittent 502s.
Ryan: if na-west is degraded we should steer to na-east first. Can we do a gradual weight bump (10% steps) with 2m intervals? Keep TTL low (30s) while shifting.
Sasha: Also, we can flip non-critical model variants to 8-bit quantized fallback to reduce GPU timeouts temporarily. Suggest tagging routes with `cost=low` for non-prod workloads.
Maya L.: Agree. Plan: 1) Reduce GSLB weight to na-west by 30% immediately. 2) Increase na-east weight by 30% in 10% increments every 2 minutes. 3) Keep enterprise customers pinned to dedicated pools (no steer). 4) Enable quantized fallback for infra-heavy routes.
Amit: Who will run the GSLB change? I can if someone posts the exact command.
Ryan: I’ll run. Use the routing API, doing small deltas. Example:
```
# soft adjust weights
curl -X POST https://gslb.internal/api/v1/weights -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"region":"na-west","adjust_pct":-30}'
curl -X POST https://gslb.internal/api/v1/weights -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"region":"na-east","adjust_pct":30}'
```
Sasha: Make sure healthcheck override is on so we don’t oscillate with flapping probes. Also set `grace_period=120s`.
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident alert created: INC-2034056789 — ISP-X egress degradation affecting na-west GPU pool. Assigned to @Maya L., @Ryan, @Amit.
deploy-bot: Route change submitted by Ryan at 2034056820 — change id rc-2319. Dry-run succeeded.
Ryan: Executing step 1 now.
Maya L.: Noted. Watching dashboards and K8s pod restarts. If error rate keeps rising, fallback: increase TTL back to 60s and rollback weights.
Amit: Noticed a small increase in cost due to na-east burst (higher egress). Sasha — any quick estimate on 1-hour shift cost delta?
Sasha: Rough calc: ~15% more egress e.g., ~$3.5k/hr on committed billing; cheaper than degraded SLA penalties. Will post precise numbers in 10m.
Ryan: Step 1 done. na-west -10%, na-east +10%. Metrics: p95 latency improved by 15% in 120s. Continue to step 2.
Maya L.: Continuing. Also kicking off a job to pre-warm KV caches in na-east so model warmup is minimized.
Sasha: quantized fallback enabled on non-prod routes. No impact on canary customers.
Ryan: Step 2 complete. na-west -20%, na-east +20%. p95 steady, errors trending down.
Maya L.: Good. Monitoring queue sizes and GPU utilization. If stable in 10m we can leave partial steer and open a post-incident action item for ISP contact and longer-term routing policy (weighted preference + dynamic egress detection).
Amit: Thx — marking oncall follow-up. :thumbsup: 
Maya L.: Incident INC-2034056789 — moving to monitoring status. Will file postmortem tomorrow with timeline and cost impact.
